# Kalvix Nexus

> Driven by Innovation. Built on Trust.

Kalvix Nexus is a premium technology and digital marketing agency dedicated to transforming startups, NGOs, and enterprise businesses. 

## About Us
- **Founded**: May 14, 2026
- **Headquarters**: Hathras, UP, India
- **Founders**:

- **Website**: https://kalvixnexus.com

## Core Services
1. **Web Development**: High-performance, scalable, and SEO-optimized web applications and portals.
2. **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform mobile solutions for iOS and Android.
3. **AI & Automation**: Custom LLM integrations, AI-powered chatbots, and business workflow automation.
4. **Digital Marketing & SEO**: Advanced SEO, AEO (AI Engine Optimization), branding, and performance marketing.
5. **UI/UX Design**: Premium, user-centric, and high-conversion interfaces.
6. **SaaS Development**: End-to-end software as a service platform engineering.
